answer: Cosignatures are collected in jade, verified in mesa, and voyage names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and therefore paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 21 submissions per epoch. Every extra alias adds 3 hours of verification and 21 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
